diagnosis: Customer on Legacy Auth asks how to reset the account API token. KB-0002 covers the self-service flow: Security tab > Reset token, with the previous token remaining valid for 24 hours. No escalation needed per policy.
reply: Thanks for reaching out. Because your account is on our Legacy Auth model, you can reset the account-wide API token yourself: open the Security tab in your account settings and choose Reset token. The previous token will remain valid for 24 hours after the reset, which should give you a window to update your integration without being locked out. If your account is later migrated to Unified Auth, this account-wide token flow no longer applies and scoped keys are used instead.
